justification: Inspected `javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/cache/{DefaultCacheStats,GuavaCache,NoCache,InMemoryCache}.java`, `javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/resolution/typesolvers/{CombinedTypeSolver,JavaParserTypeSolver}.java`, and `javaparser-symbol-solver-testing/src/test/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/resolution/typesolvers/CombinedTypeSolverTest.java`. The target package is a small adapter layer: it has only 2 production internal clients (`CombinedTypeSolver`, `JavaParserTypeSolver`) plus 1 test client, and its classes depend mainly on `com.github.javaparser.resolution.cache` (Cache/CacheStats) plus Guava in `GuavaCache`. The same `resolution.cache` API is already used by the higher-level solvers, so there is no concrete evidence that `com.github.javaparser.symbolsolver.cache` depends on a less stable package than itself.
